algorithm.title: Audio enhancement
algorithm.description: Uses the installed NVIDIA Broadcast app. Buffered processing adds seconds of latency.

window_seconds.title: Buffer window (0 = automatic)
window_seconds.description: Automatic: 2 seconds for denoising/echo removal, 8 seconds for Studio Voice. Custom windows must be at least 2 seconds; realtime Studio Voice requires at least 8.

alignment_delay_ms.title: Content delay (-1 = automatic)
alignment_delay_ms.description: Validated Broadcast 2.3 uses 70 ms for denoising/echo removal and 40 ms for Studio Voice. Unknown versions require an explicit override.

gateway_port.title: Gateway port (0 = automatic)
gateway_port.description: Automatically reads the installed app gateway. Overrides are limited to its loopback ports 18100–18109.
